record.question: Which one of the following film is declared as the best film in 63rd film fare Awards?
record.explanation: Filmfare's 63rd awards list (20 January 2018) explicitly names Hindi Medium as Best Film. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.filmfare.com/awards/filmfare-awards-2018/winners Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
